name: io.github.friehub/frensense
description: Deterministic static analysis and code scanning MCP server. Directory audit, single-file scan for agent edit loops, and diff-scoped scan of only added lines. Taint paths from source to sink for TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust and C.

environmentVariables.name: FRENSENSE_CORPUS_BUNDLE
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a .frc knowledge bundle so learned facts participate in agent scans

tools.name: frensense_audit
tools.description: Audit a directory for vulnerabilities with full source-to-sink taint paths

tools.name: frensense_scan_file
tools.description: Scan a single file, designed for agent edit loops

tools.name: frensense_diff
tools.description: Scan a unified diff and report only findings on added lines
